4645.title: Codex MCP approvals stop before reaching thread interactions
4645.rootCauseOneLine: The Codex bridge rejects MCP elicitations before emitting a runtime interaction; Codex converts the client error into a decline.
4645.proposedFix: Capture the live Browser Use request, then add validated elicitation routing and response encoding while preserving form metadata and permission semantics.
4645.caveats: Repeated bridge-level proof in two trusted checkouts; live Chrome, auto-mode success, and saved browser permissions remain unverified. The permission/security boundary excludes a simple automated fix. Full reproduction sources are inline because the reports repository forbids standalone artifacts.
